name: Site tokens
description: The site's tokens in two colour themes and two contrast levels. The build emits every colour role that differs between the themes as a light-dark() pair (the page follows the system or <html data-theme>, and a subtree can switch with color-scheme), and the roles the 'more' contrast context changes inside @media (prefers-contrast: more).

base.description: Primitives, scales, type, motion and component tokens.

contrast.description: The contrast the reader asks for (prefers-contrast).
